caption: The orange region is removed near q and the purple region is added near p. The line pq splits them into the paired curvilinear pieces used in the comparison lemma. Their boundaries include circular arcs, so straight-triangle areas would give the wrong subtraction. Dashes show the original boundary; the solid gray curve is the replacement.
alt: Two views of the same shortest-arc replacement, with the removed curved cap shaded orange and the added curved cap shaded purple; points p, q, r, s, a, b, c, d are marked.
